title: Delightful and worth every penny
text: I love it. The cats love it. It brings fun and joy by popping up on what seems like a random day. Surprise. It’s fun day. I particularly like that it included an interactive toy that required my participation, although only briefly. One cat went for the toy on the string and just like that another cat grabbed the little wand right out of my hand and they were off. Seems “interactive” doesn’t necessarily require an adult to operate.
label: positive
